summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of ShinobiClash theme toggle and Arena visual refresh features. All visual changes, interactive elements, and battle speed memory persistence verified successfully.
passed_tests: Login page theme toggle button (data-testid=login-theme-toggle) is present and functional

Background image filters shift correctly between themes: light mode applies sepia/warm tone (saturate-0.85, sepia-0.15, brightness-1.05), dark mode applies neutral/cool tone (saturate-1, sepia-0, brightness-1)
Scrim gradient overlays shift correctly: light mode uses warm amber-brown (#2E2412), dark mode uses cool near-black (#05050A)
Auth form remains fully functional after theme toggle (email, password, submit button all accessible)
Login with admin credentials (admin@shinobi.com / admin123) works correctly via quick login button
Arena page loads successfully with all visual refresh elements
Arena rank badge (data-testid=arena-rank-badge) displays correctly with rank name 'Jonin' matching player rating tier (1520)
Arena stat cards display correctly with icon badges: Rating=1520, Record=26W-0L, Attempts Left=0/5
Arena VS matchup strip renders correctly showing player rating vs opponent name with glowing VS divider
Opponent squad renders using HeroPortrait component (data-testid=arena-opponent-hero-0, -1, -2) with visible rarity-colored borders and hero name+level overlays
'Find Another' button (data-testid=arena-refresh-btn) is functional and fetches new opponents
'FIGHT' button (data-testid=arena-fight-btn) is present and correctly disabled when no attempts remain (proper state management)
Arena page renders correctly in both light and dark themes (verified via screenshots)
Battle Speed Memory: AUTO toggle (data-testid=pref-auto-toggle) in BattleHub correctly sets localStorage key 'sc_battle_auto'
Battle Speed Memory: Speed toggle (data-testid=pref-speed-toggle) in BattleHub correctly sets localStorage key 'sc_battle_speed'
Battle Speed Memory: Preferences persist correctly when starting a battle from BattleHub (AUTO ON and 2X speed maintained)
Battle Speed Memory: Preferences persist correctly after browser reload (localStorage values unchanged)
Battle page displays AUTO toggle (data-testid=battle-auto-toggle) and speed toggle (data-testid=battle-speed-toggle) with correct values
No critical console errors on Login or Arena pages (only expected 401 on initial /api/auth/me and benign Cloudflare RUM requests)
